duration: Stop and establish ownership/vendor state; no rushed recovery
cost: Retain shared tools and existing cloud resources
summary: Recover without laptop rollback, broad uninstall or source loss. Stopped-partial setup, sample fallback and narrow owned-output cleanup are different decisions.
action_notice: Recovery/cleanup are human-operated only. Agents never execute real-checkout cleanup, reset, repair, setup/WhatIf, Restore, mass process/container actions or deployment.

purpose.p: Retain installed tools/settings/accounts/distro data and every unrelated source/editor change while resolving the actual blocker.
Default cleanup is a nonmutating ownership plan, not a workstation uninstaller or demo-reset wrapper. Missing/ambiguous ownership never means permission to adopt or delete.

starting_state.p: Identify the specific task/vendor/process and source checkout. Wait for setup/resume and app/test/Restore tasks to finish before suggesting clone update or cleanup. Save unsaved editor work.

steps.title: Treat a force-closed legacy base as stopped partial

body.p: No automatic Finish/SkipBase, reboot/resume, restart, repair or rollback. Preserve everything already installed. Establish vendor/elevated-child and required/pending restart state before another module/download.
Read known logs/state and actual final summary/flagged steps. A live PID, lock or log activity is not successful completion; do not force-clear a lock or blindly repeat installers.

steps.expect: Truthful stopped/failed/uncertain state and approved next decision, never success inferred from partial output.

steps.title: Retain state and inventory genuine missing targets
steps.where: Reviewed installed-first module source › Human decision

body.p: Normal recovery is reviewed local installed-first inventory, not the broad legacy bundle. Compatible installed targets retain version/location/settings and skip before downloads; unknown/incompatible registered state is retained and stops.

Known Python/pwsh discovery can work despite stale VS Code PATH. Save and fully exit/reopen from Windows when needed; do not globally rewrite PATH/JAVA_HOME/profile/Copilot accounts or reset/update distros.

steps.expect: A narrow actual missing-target review, with no agent setup/preview/repair execution.

steps.title: Preserve all source and choose a safe prepared fallback
steps.where: Source Control › File: Open Folder › Separate reviewed checkout

ol: Stop agent edits and preserve staged, unstaged, untracked and unsaved work.
Prefer a separately prepared reviewed clean main checkout or inspected demo-complete schedule fallback; never switch a dirty/shared/active checkout.
Verify actual ref/content before human tests/launches. Historical demo-baseline is unsafe, never a run/reset/deployment source.
Deployment from a fallback branch is forbidden. A user-approved sample reset is a separate explicit exercise, not routine cleanup.

steps.expect: A known safe source/fallback while all unrelated work and the historical tag remain retained.

steps.title: Preview narrow ownership only after tasks finish

body.p: Inspect newly recorded exact unchanged file identities/fingerprints. Shared tools/GHCP/extensions, accounts, environments/module/cache trees, source, logs outside the checkout, WSL/data and cloud resources are always retained.
Agents validate cleanup with isolated fixtures/mocks only, never a real checkout even for the default plan. Missing/changed/ambiguous ownership retains; no adoption or repository-wide sweep.

steps.expect: A human-reviewed nonmutating exact ownership plan, not permission to remove a folder because it looks generated.

steps.title: Apply only separately confirmed exact owned outputs
steps.where: Terminal › Run Task › Cleanup generated resources

body.p: Only after reviewing the plan, the human explicitly confirms exact unchanged newly owned files. Containers require separate exact immutable workspace-labelled ownership/opt-in, never name-based mass remove or prune.

Do not delete .venv/.tools/target/HTML/cache trees, shared SDK/extensions/Copilot/accounts/distros, primary clone, Downloads contents, source, external logs or cloud resources. The committed companion is source, not a disposable cleanup tree.

steps.expect: Only exact positively owned unchanged authorized outputs removed; everything else retained.

expected.p: The actual failure is surfaced while installed/shared state and unrelated work remain intact. Cleanup, sample reset, setup, Restore and deployment remain distinct approvals.

success.p: Inspect actual source status and the exact retained/eligible ownership plan. Verify vendor/restart uncertainty is resolved before any human retry. No laptop rollback or new baseline tag is assumed.

failures.symptom: Timeout/cancelled installer may still be running
failures.fix: Pause further installers/downloads and establish the specific owned process/outcome with IT. No mass termination or blind retry.

failures.cause: Identity/fingerprint or original ownership cannot be proven
failures.fix: Retain it; do not adopt, recursively delete or relax the identity check.

failures.symptom: Primary clone/another session has unrelated work
failures.fix: Do not update/reset/switch it. Save and retain work; use a separately reviewed prepared checkout.

failures.symptom: Unsafe baseline suggested as demo fallback
failures.cause: Historical deliberate defects mistaken for safe source
failures.fix: Never run/reset/deploy it. Inspect revised main or the separate schedule fallback instead.

recovery.p: Read-only inspection and source/mocks are permitted; state-changing actions require their distinct authorized human path. No blanket delete/reset --hard/clean/container prune, policy bypass, repair, auth or cloud mutation.

limitations.p: This page did not run cleanup, reset, vendor repair, module preview/apply or inspect a live laptop's owned processes. Manual ticks are not retention/cleanup proof.

say: Stopped partial is not successful base, rollback or automatic resume.
I retain shared tools, accounts, distros and unrelated source work.
Cleanup removes only exact positively owned unchanged outputs, never a workstation tree.
evidence_gaps: No live vendor/reboot state, clone update, reset, cleanup or ownership deletion was observed/performed by the companion.
